question: Will the Baltimore Orioles win the 2026 World Series?
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 MLB World Series per the rules of MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from MLB (https://www.mlb.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: **As of early September 2026, the Dodgers hold the top implied probability at 32.5% in the MLB World Series futures market, driven by their strong NL West lead near 86-57 and elite roster depth featuring stars like Shohei Ohtani.** The Brewers sit second at 13.2% on the strength of their MLB-best or near-best record around 88-56 and NL Central dominance. AL contenders follow, with the Rays (8.3%) atop the AL East at 85-58, the Yankees (9.5%) at 81-62, and the Braves (7.1%) holding the NL East at 85-59. Other factors shaping trader consensus include late-season momentum, divisional standings, and pitching/hitting production from players like Pete Crow-Armstrong and Yordan Alvarez. The stretch-run schedule and health of key contributors continue to influence positioning among the top clubs.
